Canonical image references required for identity/landmark matching: 1003010001；1003010004；1003010005；1003010006. These references control recurring face, age, silhouette, palette, material, and landmark geometry; they do not control camera or pose.

Source-bound continuity facts: 无额外条目

MythCanvas locked continuity design: ymir: Colossal pre-world humanoid with dark frost-stone skin, massive brow and nose, deep-set pale eyes, and long frost-white hair and beard.；ymir: Ancient and elemental rather than a normal Viking warrior; no armor, helmet, weapons, or tailored costume.；ymir: Maintain the same facial bone structure, hairline, beard shape, and relative scale in every appearance.；odin-creator: Mature dual-eyed creator with dark brown braided hair and beard, charcoal fur cloak, and calm commanding posture.；odin-creator: No missing eye, ravens, Gungnir-like spear, throne, Valhalla imagery, or rune-mastery attributes in this early timeline.；vili: Youthful athletic adult with wheat-blond shoulder-length hair, clean face or minimal stubble, light slate wrap, and active forward motion.；ve: Compact steady adult with dark hair tied back in a short topknot, restrained beard or clean jaw, dark gray cloak, and grounded ritual posture.

Identity anchors: 无额外条目

Must keep: 无额外条目

Must avoid: 无额外条目

Composition: camera clear subject-first camera; shot single readable composition; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Series-wide visual grammar: keep matte painterly surfaces；broad readable forms；limited focal sharpness；quiet atmospheric negative space；restrained blue-white frost and ember light；subject detail clearly stronger than background detail; avoid glossy game-CG rendering；hyper-detailed-everything；generic Viking cosplay；floating realm platforms；science-fiction orbit graphics；random glowing runes；multiple competing focal centers.

Color and material guidance: palette 无额外条目; materials 无额外条目; mood 无额外条目.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010001. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: typography；logo；card frame；watermark；battle clutter；formed world landscape；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.
